question: Which of the following chemicals is NOT used as a food preservative to check the growth of microorganisms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium hydrogen carbonate.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The common name of sodium hydrogen carbonate is Baking soda.__

 __
 
• It is also called Sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃).
 
• It is used as a leavening **agent, fungicide, pest control, mild disinfectant, fire extinguisher, neutralization of acids, and Cleaning agent, etc.**
